chapter: Clarinet and lessons with Jim Humphrey
title: Rehearsing at St. Catherine Hall near Tulane Avenue
summary: He recalls a band rehearsing in a church hall near Charity Hospital where others stood behind him as he read.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: And I appreciated it. I didn't like it, but I said, playing out, you know, in the street. Yeah. And so we used to have a little band. We used to rehearse at a place they called, uh, right here in this city. And, uh, place they called, uh, it's a church. They got a school there, I think. Right downtown there on Tulane Avenue, I think. We were in that vicinity. And, uh, we used to play, and the boys all, you know, they used to come in the back of me, I was playing, uh, the first client. Is that near, yeah. Is that near Charity Hospital?
There's a hall there they call it St. Catherine.

Exactly, that's the place. I know the other one. Well, we used to go there and everybody, everybody stand in the back of me, you know, see if I'm reading this right, you know. And they said, it's doggone, I used to play at them partners, you know. I was in the band with them there, a pretty two-piece band, I think. And I used to play a clannin. And they all would stand in the back of me all the time, see. I used to be glad that, you know.
